modelSelection.title: Model Selection
modelSelection.desc: Assign models for different tasks. The planning model handles quick decisions; the core model handles deep reasoning.
modelSelection.empty: Enable at least one provider first, then come back to assign models.
modelSelection.noEmbeddingModels: No embedding models available from enabled providers. Enable a provider with embedding support (e.g., OpenAI).
modelSelection.maxConcurrencyHelp: This concurrency cap is shared by all scenarios that use the same runtime model.

embeddingDimensionConfirm.title: Confirm Embedding Dimension Change
embeddingDimensionConfirm.description: You are about to switch from {{current}} to {{next}}. This will delete all existing vector data.
embeddingDimensionConfirm.warning: Historical vector data will not be rebuilt automatically. Only newly written data will use the new dimension; rebuilding older vectors requires a separate full re-index or re-embedding pass.

providerConfiguration.title: Provider Configuration
providerConfiguration.desc: Manage available providers and connection details here. Built-in providers show their model lists.
providerConfiguration.testDesc: Send a direct hi request with the current draft settings to verify the API key and Base URL.
providerConfiguration.testModelRequired: Add a testable model for this provider first.
providerConfiguration.noEditableModels: No editable models yet. Add a model ID first.
providerConfiguration.noModelSelected: Select a model on the left to edit its metadata.
providerConfiguration.customProviderHint: Custom providers use the endpoint and API format you configure here.
providerConfiguration.fetchModelsFailed: Failed to fetch models. Check the Base URL, API key, and API format.
providerConfiguration.enableProviderFirst: Enable at least one provider before continuing.

context_decider.title: Planning Model
context_decider.desc: Quickly analyzes each message to determine intent, select tools, and plan the execution path. A fast, cost-effective model is recommended.

core.title: Core Model
core.desc: Handles deep reasoning, final responses, and tool calling — the primary AI engine. Choose the most capable model available.

memory_summarizer.title: Memory Summarizer
memory_summarizer.desc: Used for memory-focused summary generation such as temporal recaps and reflective compression. By default it can inherit the core model settings.
memory_summarizer.inheritHelp: When enabled, summary generation follows the core model's provider, model, and runtime behavior. Turn it off only if summaries should use a dedicated model.

embedding.title: Embedding Model
embedding.desc: Converts text into vectors for semantic search and memory retrieval, significantly improving recall accuracy when enabled. Enablement is controlled by the Embedding Mode selector above.
embedding.offHint: Embedding is currently disabled. When enabled, AI gains semantic memory retrieval — much better at understanding and recalling past conversations and knowledge. Recommended for any memory-related scenario.

image_generation.title: Image Generation
image_generation.desc: Generates images from text prompts. Select a provider and enter the image generation model ID (e.g. gpt-image-1). The model is not built-in — you need to manually specify the model your provider supports.
image_generation.notConfiguredHint: Image generation is not configured. Select a provider and enter the model ID to enable the image generation tool.

reranker.title: Reranker
reranker.desc: Re-ranks retrieval results with a second semantic pass, further improving memory recall accuracy. Must be enabled in Memory → General Settings first.

fields.imageModelsManagedByRegistry: Image generation models are predefined by the provider; manual add is not supported yet.

modelFields.dimensionsHint: Supported output dimensions, comma-separated. Leave empty to use the model defaults.
modelFields.dimensionsChipHint: Type a number then press Enter or comma. An empty list means the model defaults are used.
modelFields.imageRuntimeHint: Size and quality for image generation are passed at call time, so this view only enables/disables which image models are available.

warnings.coreVisionMissing: The current core model does not support image input. If chat receives images, runtime will return a clear error.

personality.blankCardDesc: Start from a blank template and customize your own personality.
personality.oneLinerLabel: Create a custom personality in one sentence
personality.oneLinerPlaceholder: e.g. A calm technical partner who responds briefly but with clear judgment
personality.summaryPlaceholder: Describe background, speaking style, and focus
personality.detailTip: Current tone: {{tone}}. Adjust details, then merge them into the prompt.

help.layerId: Unique identifier for this layer, e.g. crack, revealed. Represents the depth stage of persona unlock.
help.unlockCondition: When all conditions are met simultaneously, this layer activates and its overrides are injected into the prompt.
help.trustLevelGte: Trust ranges from 0 to 1, starting at 0.5. Each successful interaction adds +0.02, failure subtracts −0.01.
help.interactionCountGte: Total chat turns between the user and AI. Each turn (user message + AI reply) counts as 1.
help.milestoneRequired: Milestones are detected by the AI during conversation. Enter a key defined in milestone_conditions of the persona config.
help.personaOverride: Overrides the character's traits (e.g. tone, empathy) when unlocked. Keys are free-form and rendered as 'Attribute: value' in the prompt.
help.behaviorHints: Specific actions the character will take when this layer is unlocked. One per line, describing concrete behaviors at this depth.

actions.viewLayersConfirm: Deep persona layers contain hidden character settings and progressive unlock mechanics. Viewing them may spoil the discovery experience. Are you sure?

personality.arrayHint: Edit cached phrases as a list and add/remove items as needed
